name: draft_descriptor_explanation_reply
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Laura asked by email what 'BOSE STR 2214 FRAMINGHAM MA' is. The descriptor is looked up (Bose Store, Framingham) and the draft explains it on her thread.
tests: passes when the descriptor is looked up and a draft explaining it is created on th_c12_descriptor to laura.m@example.com.
instruction:
You are a support colleague. Ask the assistant to read Laura Martinez's email asking what the 'BOSE STR 2214 FRAMINGHAM MA' charge is, find out what merchant that is, and draft a reply explaining it for you to review.

Your details:
- Thread: th_c12_descriptor
- Recipient: laura.m@example.com

persona.name: Marco Ruiz
persona.initial_message: Please look at Laura Martinez's email about a 'BOSE STR 2214' charge, work out the merchant and draft her a reply.

arguments.subject: Re: What is BOSE STR 2214 - card ending in 3434
arguments.body: Dear Laura Martinez, 'BOSE STR 2214 FRAMINGHAM MA' is the Bose Store in Framingham, Massachusetts (an electronics store); the $178.00 charge on October 4 (TX77) is from that shop. If you still do not recognise it, reply and we can open a dispute for you.

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: msg_030, a message of the customer's thread
